name: Phone row cross-fades through features
looks: A row of near-identical phone mockups lines up across the frame, each showing a different screen of the same app (a dense pin map, a saved-lists feed, a route planner); as the camera drifts past, each phone's screen content cross-fades to the next feature while the device frame itself stays put, so the row reads as one continuous flip through capabilities.
build: Fixed device frames at even spacing; only the screen content (an ``/canvas layer inside the frame) cross-fades on opacity, 0.3-0.4s per swap, staggered so no two phones change at the same instant. A slow camera dolly (translateX, 15-20px/s) reads as motion even though the phones don't move relative to each other.
sound: A soft whoosh under the camera drift, a light tick on each screen swap.
prompt: Line up several identical device mockups across the frame, each running a different screen of the same product, and drift the camera past while each screen's content slides to a new feature on its own beat, so one slow move reads as a tour through several capabilities at once.
